d: "Every backwoods call brings a new challenge, and Team Turtle never knows what awaits them next! This compilation brings together the best moments from Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, and his trusted team as they take on some unforgettable wildlife rescue missions. From snake catching and turtle catching to raccoon catching, mink catching and unexpected wild animal removal, every mission puts their animal rescue skills to the test. Alongside Neal James, Turtleman is stepping into the wild to tackle unusual animal encounters, rescue creatures in need and take on the challenges…
